title: TAP video plan
description: One 9:16 TAP video: a voiceover with word timings and an ordered list of scenes.

id.description: Your own id for this video. Echoed back in job status and the webhook.

voiceover_url.description: The voiceover audio (mp3, wav, m4a). An http(s) URL, or (CLI only) a file path relative to the plan file.

words.description: Word-level timestamps of the voiceover, in order. They drive the caption pill and the cues.

text.description: The word as it should appear in the caption (for example "$5" or "240+").

duration.description: Total length in seconds. Default: the later of the last scene end and the last word end + `tail`.

tail.description: Seconds the last scene holds after the last word.

music.description: Optional background music, looped under the voice and faded out over the last 2 s.

url.description: An http(s) URL, a path relative to the plan file (CLI only), or `music/tap-bed.mp3` for the bundled track.

volume.description: Linear gain of the music. 0.023 is the level of the reference ads (about 26 dB under the voice).

start.description: Seconds to skip at the start of the track.

captions.description: The karaoke caption pill (1-3 words, current word in orange).

y.description: Vertical centre of the pill in pixels.

start.description: Start time in seconds. Defaults to the end of the previous scene.

end.description: End time in seconds. Use this or `duration`.

duration.description: Length in seconds. Use this or `end`.

continue.description: Hard cut from the previous scene with no entry transition (for a scene that continues the same picture).

url.description: The clip: an http(s) URL, or (CLI only) a file path relative to the plan file. MP4 (H.264) or MOV.

startFrom.description: Seconds to skip at the start of the clip.

clipSeconds.description: Length of the clip in seconds. Set it when the scene is longer than the clip, so the clip loops instead of running out.

volume.description: Volume of the clip's own sound (0 = muted).

fit.description: How the clip fills the 9:16 frame.

dim.description: Darken the whole clip by this much.

head.description: White headline line(s) under the tag. `*word*` gets the orange highlight box.

lines.description: Headline lines between the tapes. `*word*` gets the orange highlight box.

items.description: The pills. `cue` is when each one pops in.

flip.description: Start each mark as a cross and flip it to a tick 0.3 s later.

foot.description: Footer line under the pills (shown in the orange highlight box).

tape.description: Text of the diagonal orange ticker tape across the top. Leave out for no tape.
Text of the diagonal orange ticker tape across the top. Leave out for no tape.

flipCue.description: Show a block stack above the headline and flip it over at this cue.

head.description: Headline above the phones. `*word*` is highlighted.

cues.description: When each platform badge pops in.

covers.description: Cover photos for the phones (bundled names or image URLs).

icon.description: A platform (telegram, tiktok, instagram, youtube, x) or a line icon (app, store, play, user, users, tag, gift, mail, doc, globe, clock, heart, sparkle, book, images, phone, lock, flag, check).

sources.description: Icon cards (leave out for the headline version).

boxCue.description: Swap the logo for the product box at this cue.

title.description: Title lines on the orange band.

subtitle.description: Small line at the bottom of the box.

foot.description: A line under the box (use instead of `lessons`).

number.description: The number on the tile (one or two characters).

icon.description: A platform (telegram, tiktok, instagram, youtube, x) or a line icon (app, store, play, user, users, tag, gift, mail, doc, globe, clock, heart, sparkle, book, images, phone, lock, flag, check).

price.description: Price on the tag. A leading currency symbol is drawn in orange.
Price block on the button. `null` hides it.

blocks.description: Blocks, bottom to top. The top one is orange.

cues.description: [icon 1, icon 2, icon 3, have card, need card].

icon.description: A platform (telegram, tiktok, instagram, youtube, x) or a line icon (app, store, play, user, users, tag, gift, mail, doc, globe, clock, heart, sparkle, book, images, phone, lock, flag, check).
Line icon on the right-hand card.

cover.description: Slideshow cover photo: a bundled name (recipe, travel, apps, gym, study, desk) or an image URL.

tape.description: Text of the diagonal orange ticker tape across the top. Leave out for no tape.

cover.description: Slideshow cover photo: a bundled name (recipe, travel, apps, gym, study, desk) or an image URL.
Slideshow cover photo: a bundled name (recipe, travel, apps, gym, study, desk) or an image URL.

upload_url.description: The finished MP4 is sent here with an HTTP PUT (a pre-signed S3 / R2 / GCS URL works as is).

thumbnail_upload_url.description: The JPEG thumbnail is sent here with an HTTP PUT.

upload_headers.description: Extra headers for both uploads (for example an Authorization header).

public_url.description: The URL the video will be readable at after upload. Reported back as `video_url`.

thumbnail_time.description: Second of the video to use as the thumbnail.

webhook_url.description: POST /render only: called with the job result when the render finishes or fails.
